PF 60 exceeds HS 59 (foot penetrated to ground). PS blank. Dark red line across the bar at 18 cm is the SnowPilot problematic-layer marker. Photo of the same pit is a separate not_a_profile JSON; the photo labels the lower crust 'Oct 21' whereas the chart notes say 'Oct 20'.
